name: OmaCRT
author: Stefano Mainardi
description: Drive a 15 kHz CRT television from the Omarchy bar: power the tube on and off, NTSC or PAL, DAC sync, audio to the TV, launcher focus, library and BIOS health.

barWidget.description: 15 kHz CRT output: power, standard, DAC, audio, launcher

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon re-reads the CRT status. The panel refreshes every 2 seconds while open.

schema.label: Hide when no DAC is connected
schema.description: Hide the bar icon while no CRT DAC is plugged into an HDMI output.
